lines.zh: 帆背一摇，我沿沙地慢慢走
lines.en: My sail sways as I plod along the sand.

lines.zh: 四足踏过平原，草叶被压倒
lines.en: Four feet cross the plain, flattening the grass.

lines.zh: 我迈着沉重的步子找嫩叶
lines.en: Heavy steps carry me toward the tender leaves.

lines.zh: 沙土松软，我的脚陷下去一半
lines.en: The sand is soft; my feet sink halfway in.

lines.zh: 沿着河岸走，脚下有水声
lines.en: I follow the riverbank, water murmuring below.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，帆却在风里响
lines.en: I walk slowly, but my sail crackles in the wind.

lines.zh: 前面有灌木，我打算绕过去
lines.en: Shrubs ahead; I mean to go around them.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，扫开挡路的草
lines.en: One sweep of my tail clears the grass.
Head low, I sniff as I go.

lines.zh: 一步一顿，我在丈量这片平原
lines.en: Step by step, I measure out this plain.

lines.zh: 走过热沙，背上帆影投在地上
lines.en: Over hot sand, my sail's shadow falls ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我踩碎枯枝，声音传得很远
lines.en: A dry branch snaps and the sound carries far.
I lead my herd toward the green.

lines.zh: 我听见远处水声，就朝那边走
lines.en: I hear water far off and turn toward it.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的风，吹得帆面鼓起来
lines.en: Cretaceous wind fills the sail on my back.
My footprints press deep into the ground.

lines.zh: 走累了，我在石边停一停
lines.en: Weary, I pause beside a stone.
Slow as I am, I never stop for long.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，帆迎着太阳
lines.en: I stand still with my sail to the sun.
Wind passes over my sail; I narrow my eyes.
Grass sways at my feet; I can't be bothered.
I shift my weight onto my hind legs.

lines.zh: 沙地上只有我的影子在动
lines.en: Only my shadow moves on the sand.

lines.zh: 我抬头听了一会儿，什么也没有
lines.en: I lift my head, listen, hear nothing.

lines.zh: 鼻子动了动，风里有水汽
lines.en: My nostrils flare; there's moisture in the wind.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼着嘴里的叶子
lines.en: I chew the leaf in my mouth, slowly.

lines.zh: 站久了，尾巴扫开一只虫
lines.en: Standing long, I flick a bug away with my tail.
The sun warms my sail; it feels good.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处的地平线发呆
lines.en: I stare at the far horizon, thinking of nothing.

lines.zh: 有云影移过来，我眨眨眼
lines.en: A cloud's shadow crosses me; I blink.

lines.zh: 四足钉在原地，像块石头
lines.en: Four feet planted, I might as well be stone.

lines.zh: 我半闭着眼，风一停就醒
lines.en: Half asleep, I wake the moment the wind dies.
A small fly lands on my back.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，又静下来
lines.en: I snort once, then settle again.

lines.zh: 你太小了，我得低头看你
lines.en: You're so small; I have to lower my head.

lines.zh: 你的影子进到我脚边了
lines.en: Your shadow has reached my feet.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但我不介意
lines.en: I don't know you, and I don't mind.

lines.zh: 你把我的帆当成石头了吧
lines.en: You took my sail for a rock, didn't you?

lines.zh: 我抬眼，脖子上的褶皱动了动
lines.en: I raise my eyes; the folds on my neck shift.
How long will you stand there? I'll wait.
You smell of grass to me.
Don't stand in front of me; you block the wind.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶看过去，像看一丛草
lines.en: I look past you as if you were a tuft of grass.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就往后退半步
lines.en: You reach out; I take half a step back.
I tilt my head, and my sail tilts too.

lines.zh: 你好高啊——不，是我看低了
lines.en: You're tall — no, I was looking too low.
My hide is thick, but it still hurts.
I pull my neck in.

lines.zh: 帆上挨了一下，抖个不停
lines.en: A hit on my sail and it won't stop quivering.
Who's hitting me? I turn around.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，脚在沙里打滑
lines.en: I back off two steps, feet slipping in sand.
The wound is shallow — don't try again.
I breathe out a plume of hot air.

lines.zh: 血的味道我自己都闻得到
lines.en: Even I can smell my own blood.
I guard my flank; it's the thin side.
It hurts, but I won't run.
Are those tender leaves in your hand?
I smell fresh grass.
That bundle of ferns looks fine.
I stretch my neck — can I reach it?

lines.zh: 你把叶子举高，我就过来
lines.en: Hold the leaves up and I'll come.

lines.zh: 我只会为绿色停下脚步
lines.en: Only green things make me stop.
A little closer; I don't bite.

lines.zh: 这味道像我出生的那片河岸
lines.en: That smell is like the riverbank where I hatched.
I come slowly; I won't snatch it.
Put it down and I'll help myself.
There's still dew on those leaves.
I smell the flower and the stem both.
Don't wave it; it makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 我鼻子先到，嘴就会跟着
lines.en: My nose arrives first; my mouth follows.
One bite is enough; I'm not greedy.
Leave me some; don't put it all away.
Sorry — I take up a lot of room.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，疼的是你吧
lines.en: You hit my leg; that must hurt you.
I turn aside for you; the path is narrow.

lines.zh: 帆背晃了一下，我站稳了
lines.en: My sail rocked once; I kept my footing.

lines.zh: 别贴太近，我转身会扫到你
lines.en: Don't press close; my turn would sweep you away.

lines.zh: 尾巴碰到你了，我不是故意的
lines.en: My tail touched you; I didn't mean it.
I step back and let you pass.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我皮都皱了
lines.en: That bump wrinkled my hide.
Pushing through will trample the grass — slow down.

lines.zh: 我的影子先撞上你，然后才是身体
lines.en: My shadow hits you first, then the rest of me.
Your sail is a size smaller than mine.
We walk side by side by the river.

lines.zh: 我低头碰了碰你的脖子
lines.en: I lower my head and touch your neck.
Two sails face the wind together.
You go first; I'll follow.

lines.zh: 我们在同一片草地上停留
lines.en: We linger on the same patch of grass.
You sniff me, and I sniff you back.
No need to fight; there's grass enough here.
I'll keep you company until the sun goes down.

lines.zh: 明年这个时候，还在这里
lines.en: Same place, this time next year.

lines.zh: 这枝我够得着，不用你捡
lines.en: I can reach this branch without your help.
I pick up the fallen fruit in my mouth.
That leaf on the ground is mine.
My sail swayed and nearly touched it.
I pick up what fell, one piece at a time.
This piece is too small for a bite.
I take the tender ones first.

lines.zh: 你放的？那我就不客气了
lines.en: You left it? Then I'll take it.
My mouth is big; I don't pick things up neatly.

lines.zh: 我抖抖脖子，碎叶落回去
lines.en: I shake my neck and the crumbs fall out.
That tree moved — just wind, I think.

lines.zh: 有东西从灌木后绕过来
lines.en: Something is coming around the shrubs.
Hoofbeats — not mine.

lines.zh: 沙丘上有个影子立起来
lines.en: A shape rises on the dune.

lines.zh: 那是只小兽，我只看一眼
lines.en: Just a small beast; I'll only look.
I turn my body to face it.
Who snapped my dry branch?
A scent comes down the wind.
I raise my head and my sail stiffens.

lines.zh: 这个方向刚才还是空的
lines.en: This direction was empty a moment ago.
It hasn't left that patch of grass.
I close in, step by step.
No hurry; it can't outrun me.
I watch and wait for it to move first.
The gap narrows; I count my steps.
It's hiding from my shadow.
I raise my head and fix its position.
My steps are slower than its, but steadier.
A little closer and I'll understand.
It hasn't gone far; the scent lingers.
I merely bring my forefoot down.
This shove is just to move you back.
No teeth needed; one foot will do.
I swing my sail across.
Head lowered, I butt forward.
My tail lashes out with a whistle.
Don't blame me; you came too close.
I press down and the ground gives.

lines.zh: 这一下是警告，不是追杀
lines.en: That was a warning, not a hunt.
Breathing hard, I pull my foot back.
I rise out of the sand.
Waking, I find everything too bright.

lines.zh: 这片平原比我记得的更绿
lines.en: This plain is greener than I remember.
I shake the sand off my back.

lines.zh: 第一次呼吸，风就吹进帆里
lines.en: My first breath, and wind fills my sail.

lines.zh: 我闻到白垩纪没有的味道
lines.en: I smell things that didn't exist in my time.
My legs are weak; I hold myself up.
One of my kind calls in the distance.
I don't know where this is.
The sun is too much for my eyes.
I take a first step; the sand is fine.
This body still feels unfamiliar.
My sail caught fire and I can't shake it out.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来，我趴了很久
lines.en: I fell from a height and lay there a long while.

lines.zh: 水漫过帆顶，我踩不到底
lines.en: Water closes over my sail; my feet find no bottom.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，我耳朵嗡到现在
lines.en: A blast; my ears are still ringing.
Something bit into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 一股看不见的力量拧着我
lines.en: An unseen force twists me inside.

lines.zh: 嫩叶太少，肚子空得发慌
lines.en: Too few leaves; my belly feels hollow.

lines.zh: 雷打在我帆上，眼前发白
lines.en: Lightning struck my sail; my sight went white.

lines.zh: 我的背帆在虚空里张着，没用。
lines.en: My sail spreads in the void, and it's useless.
